g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud real-time game telemetry with Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Bigtable and BigQuery

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: Game clients send batches of events to the global load balancer
Cloud Armor rate-limits them and the collector on Cloud Run checks each batch
and publishes the events to Pub/Sub
A streaming Dataflow job reads the subscription with exactly-once processing
and writes every event to BigQuery through the Storage Write API
Dataflow updates each player's score and session in Bigtable
and scores suspicious sessions with a cheat detection model on Vertex AI
The leaderboard API reads Bigtable for clients in milliseconds
Analysts explore retention and spend in Looker on BigQuery
